scope: Proposition 7.5 (Adaptive observer and test-frame comparison) of the manuscript “Generic C1 Future Inextendibility Near Rotating Subextremal Kerr Spacetimes” (preprints/Generic-C1-Future-Inextendibility-Near-Rotating-Subextremal-Kerr-Spacetimes-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 264 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 702eacef09cb6165), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 54. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
